pages.text: The $(item)Large Meteorite Skyseed$() — a $(item)Meteorite Skyseed$() ringed in blackstone and basalt. A bigger overworld island, and a $(bold)bigger meteor$().
Everything's in hand — here's how it goes together.

$(bold)A bigger impact$()$(br)A larger island with a proportionally bigger crater and $(item)sky-stone globe$() — more sky stone from a single throw. The $(item)Meteorite Core$() at its centre yields $(bold)two different presses$() — one large meteor gets you halfway to the set.
